source_files.use: Disassembled only: BSP leaf/list, node, surface and grid loader (0x10005fe0-0x10006d0e); visibility tree builder (0x100078d4-0x10007a40); object tree insertion (0x10008287-0x1000835c); point-to-leaf descent (0x1001d0b5); ServerDE sm_IterateVisList, PingObjects and the list bitstream walk (0x1002830a-0x10028366, 0x100284c9, 0x1002b8cf-0x1002bc5b)

adaptations: PingObjects walks the decoded retail leaf visibility lists of the root BSP; worlds without a tree or lists keep the four primary-world segments (replacement, synthetic geometry only).
Every pinged object is assumed to be linked into the visibility tree by the traced retail insertion rule; the per-class selection of tree objects was not traced.
Leaf lists behind portals are decoded but never applied: portal flags (Door SetPortalState) are not modelled and default closed.
Bounded decode: a list needing bits past its own bytes, or a BSP node reached twice, fails world preparation instead of reading the next list as retail would.
Preserve manual inactivity, original player cadence/observer, AI deactivation deadlines and atomic refresh.
Bounded per-object historical query diagnostics with checked IDs and separate committed refresh flag; read-only inspector.
Authored SubwayA script/camera acceptance without forced targets, state, health, timings or edited assets.
